Track: Coordination

# STOP / SUPERSEDED AS NEXT STEP — original product intent and unchecked-localization reset

**Disposition of THIS issue: NOT PLANNED / NOT STARTED (prioritization superseded), NOT experimental HOLD/FAIL.** At this live check: Issue #365 is OPEN with **ZERO** P worker comments, no authorized work launched, and no P365 experimental result. Do **NOT** start or proceed with the proposed P G4 17-node all-checked-only verifier pilot as the automatic next H1 step.

The user reaffirmed the original **C-replacement / "Preserve the architecture, replace the bookkeeping" / "Policy-neutral, mechanism-strict"** direction: NewLang's product challenge is to let competent programmers write ordinary C-class data structures without imposed ownership/algorithm policy; guarantee static safety where realistically provable; permit programmer-justified, **explicit and localized** \`unchecked\` at genuinely unprovable low-level preconditions; avoid **unchecked PER HOP**, not prohibit any unchecked in libraries. This is already reflected in canonical Draft17.30 §8.2/§20.4/§15 and in current North Star contract §6 (per-hop unchecked0 with localized allocator/platform boundary exceptions), §8 (human obligation "moved into localized unsafe abstraction"). A prior series of H1 proof-replay experiments had begun to treat full compiler static proof of *every* operation as a de facto goal. That extra requirement is NOT preregistered product law.

**NEW next authorized gate:** [V #366](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/366), OPEN, **USER LAUNCH REQUIRED**, one read-only product/first-source-surface comparison of full checked vs valid localized unchecked vs diffuse per-hop unchecked, on the same frozen H1 original five R/O/inc/A/D, original nonCopy B + dst complete return, all 6+4+2 links/Changes/0–5 worlds. Read true v0 preconditions: unchecked is not authority mint, cannot omit required correct original-D stability, cannot make a false safety promise to safe-call API, may expose a missing source profile/hook that requires a separate narrow M review. Source-first proof and human L/R/P/V/C cost required; no retroactive change to [#268](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/268) frozen PASS, scores, H2 or [#282](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/282) separately staged automatic C migration.

**Keep exact prior evidence:** [M364](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/364#issuecomment-6120114324) finite owned8 DESIGN GO is NOT revoked; P362 composite empirical HOLD and P352/R359 generic direct9 successes remain. A future checker witness pilot may be **separately reconsidered** after V366's baseline burden and source representation review. All PRs DRAFT/DO NOT MERGE, Draft17.30 normative, no merge/spec change/new R/Q/P start. Closing THIS unstarted Issue is a sequencing choice to prevent a stale launch prompt, not a finding that full-checked H1 proof is impossible.
